regions.name: Dallas-Fort Worth (combined Century Communities / HistoryMaker Homes division, Grapevine)
regions.geography: DFW metroplex. 41 active communities pro forma at 2026-09-30 (12 Century plus 29 HistoryMaker); HistoryMaker site lists communities in Aledo, Anna, Aubrey, Benbrook, Celina, Cleburne, Corinth, Forney, Fort Worth, Heartland, Justin, Lavon, Little Elm, Red Oak, Roanoke, Royse City, Van Alstyne and Waxahachie.

profile.org_note: Not a stand-alone company any more. On 2026-10-07 Century Communities bought substantially all the assets of HMH Lifestyles, L.P. (an asset purchase, not a share purchase) and merged them with its own Dallas-Fort Worth operations into one division based in Grapevine, inside Century's Texas segment; the HistoryMaker brand and website are still live. Land and capital decisions now run through Century (EVP Jim Francescon oversees land and M&A; CFO Scott Dixon), with deals sourced by the division. The Mitchell family kept sister companies Jabez Development (land development, still developing lots for Century) and ONM Living (build-to-rent), where the old shared CFO Matt Wiggins and a VP of Land Development are listed. Leader and land head of the combined division are not published.
profile.summary: Conventional for-sale production builder, entry-level and move-up, founded 1949 in Fort Worth and long owned by the Mitchell family; about 25,000 homes built. After leaving Houston (division handed to Brohn Homes, a Clayton company, in December 2025) and San Antonio, it built only in Dallas-Fort Worth, where it added 29 active communities and roughly 458 trailing-twelve-month deliveries to Century Communities (NYSE: CCS), which bought its assets for about $160.2M of initial cash on 2026-10-07. As a land-banking prospect it now exists only through Century's Dallas division; the separate opening is the Mitchell family's retained land developer, Jabez Development, which keeps delivering lots to Century.

people.name: James Francescon
people.title: Executive Vice President, Corporate Operations, Century Communities
people.source_title: Century Communities press release: Century Communities Announces Promotion of Jim Francescon to President
people.note: Parent-company land decision-maker. Known as Jim Francescon. The release says he oversees homebuilding, land, strategy, business development and M&A, and that he led the HistoryMaker Homes, Anglia Homes and Landmark Homes of Tennessee acquisitions. Board elected him President on 2026-11-04, effective 2027-01-01 (8-K filed 2026-11-09); he is the CEO's son. Quoted in the 2026-10-08 HistoryMaker release as Executive Vice President. Reporting line to the CEO is inferred from the titles. Title note: President effective January 1, 2027.

people.name: Rob McClain
people.title: Vice President of Land Development, ONM Living
people.note: Sister company, NOT part of the Century purchase. ONM Living is the Mitchell family's build-to-rent company inside the 'HistoryMaker Family of Businesses' (HistoryMaker Homes, ONM Living, Jabez Development), all at 1038 Texan Trail, Grapevine. He is the only named land executive on any of the family's public pages. Whether he also runs land development at Jabez Development (the family land developer that keeps developing lots for Century) is not stated. Reporting line inferred from the leadership listing.

people.name: Matt Wiggins
people.title: Chief Financial Officer, HistoryMaker Homes and ONM Living
people.source_title: ONM Living site: Leadership Team (also listed as CFO on the HistoryMaker Homes leadership page)
people.note: Listed on 2026-11-19 as 'Chief Financial Officer' on the ONM Living leadership page and as 'CFO' on the HistoryMaker Homes leadership page (https://www.historymaker.com/the-historymaker-differentiators), so he is the shared finance chief of the Mitchell family businesses. CPA; Texas A&M and Harvard Business School; background in finance, accounting, capital markets and real estate per the company bio. Not public: whether he moved to Century with the homebuilding business on 2026-10-07 or stayed with the family's retained companies (ONM Living, Jabez Development). His ONM Living role is unaffected by the sale, which suggests he stays with the family platform, but that is an inference.

people.name: J. Scott Dixon
people.title: Chief Financial Officer, Century Communities
people.source_title: Century Communities Form 8-K filed 2026-11-09 (signed by the CFO)
people.note: Parent-company CFO; since 2026-10-07 the HistoryMaker business is funded from Century's balance sheet. Known as Scott Dixon. On the Q3 2026 call he said the priority is ample liquidity and holding debt to capital at or below current levels, and that 2026 guidance includes about 100 HistoryMaker deliveries. Reporting line inferred.

people.name: Nathaniel Smith
people.title: Director of Finance, ONM Living
people.source_title: ONM Living site: Leadership Team (operations team list)
people.note: Sister company, not acquired by Century. Reporting line inferred from titles.

people.name: Nelson Mitchell
people.title: Chief Executive Officer, HistoryMaker Homes; Owner and CEO, ONM Living
people.source_title: Century Communities press release: Century Communities Triples Dallas-Fort Worth Footprint with Acquisition of HistoryMaker Homes
people.note: Seller. Fourth-generation president (from 2000) of the Mitchell family business, which is now in its fifth generation. Quoted as CEO of HistoryMaker Homes in the 2026-10-08 release; listed as 'B. Nelson Mitchell, Jr., Owner | CEO' on the ONM Living leadership page and as CEO on the HistoryMaker leadership page. Sold substantially all the homebuilding assets to Century on 2026-10-07 and kept Jabez Development (land development) and ONM Living (build-to-rent), which stay independently owned. No role for him inside Century has been announced. For a land banker he is now the owner of a DFW lot developer that sells finished lots to Century, not a homebuilder CEO.

people.name: Zac Thompson
people.title: President, HistoryMaker Homes
people.source_title: HistoryMaker Homes site: The HistoryMaker Differentiators (leadership section)
people.note: President since 2024-01-01 (company timeline and 2023-07-31 company announcement); named as HistoryMaker president by HousingWire on 2026-10-08. Earlier career in finance, land operations and homebuilding operations at public builders; TCU and Harvard Business School. Century says HistoryMaker division leadership and staff joined its combined Dallas-Fort Worth division in Grapevine, and its CEO said on the Q3 2026 call that the management team has joined the Dallas division, but his title inside Century and who leads the combined division have not been published. Before the sale he reported to Nelson Mitchell; the reporting line after 2026-10-07 is not public, so it is left blank.

people.name: Robert J. Francescon
people.title: Chief Executive Officer and President, Century Communities
people.source_title: Century Communities Q3 2026 results press release (Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1)
people.note: Parent-company CEO, known as Rob Francescon. Said the HistoryMaker purchase supports the strategy of deepening share in existing markets and that it was funded with cash drawn on the revolver. Hands the President title to James Francescon on 2027-01-01 and stays CEO (8-K filed 2026-11-09).

people.name: Dale Francescon
people.title: Executive Chairman, Century Communities
people.source_title: Century Communities Q3 2026 results press release (Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1)
people.note: Parent-company co-founder. Stops being a co-principal executive officer on 2027-01-01 and continues as Executive Chairman (8-K filed 2026-11-09).

people.name: Blake Roberts
people.title: Regional President, Century Communities
people.source_title: Century Communities press release: Century Communities to Host January Grand Opening in Alvarado, TX
people.note: Quoted by Century as 'Regional President' on a Dallas-Fort Worth area community (Alvarado) in January 2026. The Texas-wide scope is taken from that context and is not spelled out in the release opened in this run. The combined Century / HistoryMaker Dallas division presumably sits in his region; not stated by the company.

people.name: Taylor Humphrey
people.title: Division President, Century Communities
people.geography: Dallas-Fort Worth (Century's division before the HistoryMaker combination)
people.source_title: Century Communities press release: Century Communities Announces Model Grand Opening & Expanded Floor Plan Lineup in Forney, TX
people.note: Quoted by Century as Division President on a Forney (Dallas-Fort Worth) community in May 2026. Tagged Inferred because Century has since combined its DFW operations with HistoryMaker into one Grapevine-based division (2026-10-07) and has not said who leads it: it could be him, HistoryMaker president Zac Thompson, or someone else. Confirm before calling.

people.name: Ty Robinson
people.title: President, ONM Living
people.note: Sister build-to-rent company, not acquired by Century. Included because ONM Living runs its own land acquisition (a 2025 job posting had its Land Acquisition Manager reporting to the President of ONM Living) and, with Jabez Development, is what the Mitchell family still owns. Reporting line inferred from the leadership listing.

gaps: Leader of the combined Century / HistoryMaker Dallas-Fort Worth division (Grapevine): not publicly disclosed. Century says HistoryMaker division leadership joined; no name or title given. Zac Thompson (HistoryMaker president) and Taylor Humphrey (Century's DFW division president as of May 2026) are the two candidates.

Head of land acquisition / land development for the HistoryMaker homebuilding business: not publicly disclosed. A 'Director of Land Acquisition' role in Grapevine was advertised under HMH Lifestyles LP (posting page undated; a search snippet dated it March 2026 and said it reported to the President); the hire is not named anywhere public.

Jabez Development (Mitchell family land developer, 1038 Texan Trail, Grapevine): no website and no published leadership. Leads only, titles not stated: Texas TDLR project registrations list Frank Burgher as owner contact for JBZ Lone Tree LLC (Van Alstyne project, registered 2025-11-10) and Bruce French for Jabez Development LP (Fort Worth project, 2018). Not added as people rows because their roles are not published.
Matt Wiggins (CFO): whether he joined Century or stayed with the Mitchell family companies is not public. He is still listed as CFO on both the HistoryMaker and ONM Living pages.
Nelson Mitchell: any continuing role with Century (consulting, transition) not disclosed.
Treasurer / controller / VP Finance of HistoryMaker Homes: not publicly disclosed.

Former market leaders are stale and omitted: Lane Wright (president, retired end of 2023); Manny Alarcon (San Antonio division president, named May 2023; HistoryMaker no longer builds in San Antonio); Houston division leadership (division moved to Brohn Homes in December 2025).
Published phones are sales and warranty lines only (833-711-1949 sales, 866-409-1949 DFW support centre); no office or executive direct lines. No email pattern found in a public source.

Research limits: the swarm's shared WebSearch allowance ran out after eight searches for this builder, so local business journals, HBA/BIA rosters and conference speaker lists were not searched. builderonline.com, therealdeal.com, connectcre.com, dallasexpress.com and citybiz.co returned 403 or a bot check and were not read. The WebFetch safety check for historymaker.com was rate-limited, so the company pages were read with curl instead.
